coverage: All nine material report paragraphs and their component assertions registered; no material claim excluded.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C01.** Revision 1 governs D-201. Its deadline was 2028-03-01 17:00 UTC, and its submission exactly at that deadline was timely.

components.target: Revision 1 applies to D-201.
D-201 deadline is 2028-03-01 17:00 UTC.
D-201 submission equals its inclusive deadline and is timely.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C02.** Revision 1 governs D-202 because accepted receipt occurred one minute before the revision boundary; later internal assignment does not change applicability.

components.target: Revision 1 applies to D-202.
Its accepted receipt is one minute before the boundary.
Later internal assignment does not alter applicability.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C03.** D-202's deadline was 2028-03-10 17:00 UTC, and its 17:01 submission that day was late.

components.target: D-202 deadline is 2028-03-10 17:00 UTC.
Its submission at 17:01 is late.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C04.** Revision 2 governs D-203 because its receipt was exactly at the boundary. Its deadline was 2028-03-08 17:00 UTC, and its submission was timely at that inclusive endpoint.

components.target: Revision 2 applies to D-203 at the exact receipt boundary.
Its deadline is 2028-03-08 17:00 UTC.
Its submission equals the inclusive deadline and is timely.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C05.** The dashboard's revision 2 labels describe the active revision at export, not the applicable revision of each case.

components.target: Dashboard labels describe the active revision on export date.
They do not describe each individual case's applicable revision.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C06.** D-204 is restricted, so the seven-day standard-case rule does not determine its deadline.

components.target: D-204 is restricted.
The seven-day standard rule does not determine D-204 deadline.

components.target: The supplied package omits Annex R.
The package establishes no exact final D-204 deadline.
This evidence does not determine D-204 submission timeliness.

components.target: A D-204 pause request is documented.

claims.report_quote: **VD-C09.** Neither supplied rule defines a fairness measure for comparing the two timetables.

components.target: Neither supplied rule defines a fairness measure for comparing timetables.
